full.title: 1. Results are indicators, not accusations
full.text: Risk scores, signals, findings and any other Coima output are automated, heuristic indicators computed over public data. They flag patterns that may warrant human review. They are not an assertion, allegation, accusation or proof that any individual or company has committed a crime, an offense or any wrongdoing. Statistical correlation is not a crime, a high score does not imply guilt, and many patterns have lawful explanations.

full.title: 2. Data source and accuracy
full.text: Data comes from official public sources (comprar.gob.ar, contratar.gob.ar, INDEC, BCRA). Its accuracy, completeness and freshness depend on those sources. Extraction or interpretation errors and outdated data may exist. No individual data point is guaranteed to be correct.

full.title: 3. Personal data
full.text: Data may include names of public officials and company information that is already public under Argentine procurement and freedom-of-information law. It is processed for public-interest, transparency and civic-oversight purposes.

full.title: 4. No warranty. Sole responsibility of the user
full.text: The software and data are provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. Any use of Coima, its data and its output is the sole responsibility of the person who makes it, under applicable law. The authors and contributors accept no liability for any third-party use of the tool or the data, nor for decisions, publications or actions taken on the basis of its output.

full.title: 5. Prohibited uses
full.text: You may not use Coima to harass, defame, discriminate against or harm people, present its indicators as proof of a crime or misconduct, or use it for any unlawful purpose. Any conclusion about specific conduct requires independent verification and, where appropriate, action by a competent authority.

full.title: 6. Correction and takedown
full.text: If you are mentioned and believe a data point is incorrect, outdated or unfairly harmful, write to polserpatricio@gmail.com. Well-founded requests are reviewed and, where appropriate, the data is corrected or removed within a reasonable time.

full.title: 7. Acceptance and changes
full.text: By accepting you declare that you have read and accepted these terms. If the terms change, you will be asked to accept them again before continuing to use Coima. Acceptance is recorded only in your browser.
